text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: I wonder if that's the end of it? For someone with a body like that, it's pretty chewy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでおしまいかしら？
図体のわりに歯ごたえのない。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: We managed to take her down, but don't let your guard down, Ram. Even if we beat her, there'll be more of her and she'll come out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとかやっつけられたけど、
油断しちゃダメよ
ラム。
この子、
倒しても増えて出てきちゃうんだから。

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Lady Emilia. Someone is running away from that direction...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリア様。
あちらから逃げてくる人が……！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Let's hurry and save her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大変！
急いで助けに行きましょう！
